# People Atlas 0.12.0 — Alpha

> [!WARNING]
> People Atlas 0.12.0 is an alpha version of the plugin. Its fundamental
> behavior is subject to change in future releases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.12.0 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
> Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

0.12.0 tidies the relationship editor: its **Relationship** section is now
split into a clear always-visible **Core** and two optional, collapsed-by-
default disclosures for the simple shortcut and relationship templates.

> [!NOTE]
> Publishing People Atlas in the Community Plugins directory remains a separate
> step from this GitHub prerelease.

## Changes

- **Clearer Relationship form:** the **Relationship** section now shows an
  always-visible Core with relationship types, both people's roles and the
  natural-language role preview, keeping the **Simple relationship** shortcut
  and the **Relationship template** toolbar tucked away in two collapse-able
  sections that are closed by default.
- **Edit convenience:** when you edit a relationship whose note already uses a
  template, that template section opens automatically so you can see and manage
  it without an extra click.
- Behavior is unchanged: templates remain copy-not-live conveniences, nothing
  is written before an explicit **Save**, and focus, scroll, disclosure state
  and accessibility guarantees are preserved.

## Breaking change / upgrade note

People Atlas 0.12.0 continues the fresh-vault-only boundary for the
presentation-first dossier layout. It does not migrate older folder layouts or
provide a backward-compatibility path for them.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
